verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general, user-definable event→action rule system for kitty, such as watchers or hooks that fire on window or command events. The closest items are a fixed automatic light/dark theme switch, user-invoked hints-kitten matching, and remote-control scripting. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
